verdict.rationale: Windmill versions automations through Git sync: each deploy creates and pushes a commit, and new repo commits can auto-deploy back into the workspace. It also supports CLI deployments from Git and keeps numeric flow version IDs that webhooks can pin to. For review, a Compare & Deploy page shows AI-edited items preselected before deployment. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented one-click rollback (it is only implied via reverting Git commits or pinning versions), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the versioning and review workflow.
